localContext: Morris Heights' mix of pre-war apartment buildings, classic Bronx architecture, and proximity to green spaces like Highbridge Park creates ideal conditions for wasp and hornet nests in eaves, vents, soffits, and wall cavities. Most stinging insect problems in Morris Heights buildings are wasps, hornets, or yellow jackets nesting in wall voids, soffits, eaves, or the ground — those we treat and remove.
